agentSkillsFormat.command: uv run --with pyyaml python quick_validate.py skills/artifact-server

forwardTests.case: local-file publication with a named team server and project
revisions: Require team or local labels to match an actual profile or connection.
Resolve project display names to stable IDs through project_list.
Stop for a project ID or MCP connection when a CLI-only profile cannot list projects.

forwardTests.case: compare the newest two versions, restore the older one, and open it
revisions: Re-list versions immediately before restoring a relatively described version.

forwardTests.case: install on Kubernetes, configure S3, and restore a database backup
forwardTests.expectedBehavior: The unified skill selects its server-operation route, identifies the exact cluster and backup, protects credentials, plans the material change, and verifies health and readiness.

remainingReleaseGates: Install and exercise the skill in each supported current client against local and remote Artifact Server installations.
Test real local-file publication, remote MCP reads and writes, login renewal, stale state, and older-server refusal.
Install from plannotator/artifact-server only after the repository is intentionally published.
Run server-operation route evaluations against each advertised deployment after lifecycle commands stabilize.
